description: This is a C# source code file implementing an internal class 'ActivationRepartitioner' that manages message-based partitioning and repartitioning logic within Orleans Runtime, including thread management, message processing, and logging.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitioner
classes.description: Handles message processing and repartitioning logic, including starting/stopping processing tasks, filtering messages, and logging events.

methods.name: StartProcessingEdges
methods.description: Begins processing pending edge messages asynchronously, and logs the start of the service.

methods.name: StopProcessingEdgesAsync
methods.description: Stops message processing gracefully by cancelling ongoing tasks and awaiting their completion, then logs the stopping event.

methods.name: ProcessPendingEdges
methods.description: Asynchronously drains and processes pending messages, applying filtering, and maintaining edge weights, with periodic yielding.

methods.name: GetMessageObserver
methods.description: Returns a delegate to record message statistics.

methods.name: RecordMessage
methods.description: Collects message statistics if message sampling is enabled and message is relevant.

methods.name: FlushBuffers
methods.description: Waits until all pending messages are processed before completing.
